edges.mechanism: Inulin-type fructans are rapidly fermented FODMAPs; colonic gas/distension provokes pain, bloating and flatulence in hypersensitive IBS colon. ITF worsened flatulence (SMD +0.85) and did not improve global IBS symptoms.
edges.evidence: MA of prebiotic RCTs, MA of fiber RCTs, pediatric fructan-challenge RCT, MRI challenge study; moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: Fructan malabsorption common in IBS (~49% positive breath test); FOS-fructans provoked more GI symptoms than gluten in self-reported NCGWS.
edges.evidence: Retrospective breath-test cohort and randomized crossover challenge trial; low certainty

edges.mechanism: IgE-mediated anaphylaxis to inulin in foods (with artichoke allergy) and to intravenous sinistrin.
edges.evidence: Case reports; very low certainty but severe outcome

edges.mechanism: HFI requires strict avoidance of fructose, sucrose and sorbitol. Inulin is largely undigested in the small intestine, but co-administered fructanase hydrolyzes fructans to fructose.
edges.evidence: Narrative review, ileostomy recovery study, fructanase RCT; no inulin study in HFI; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oligofructose-enriched inulin did not induce or maintain remission in UC or Crohn's disease and caused more flatulence/bloating.
edges.evidence: SR/MA of 17 studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: In dysbiotic (e.g. TLR5-deficient) mice, dietary inulin fermentation caused cholestasis and hepatocellular carcinoma, dependent on microbiota and secondary bile acids. No human data.
edges.evidence: Preclinical mouse studies only

edges.mechanism: Metformin blunted most inulin-induced microbiota and metabolic changes in obese patients; both cause GI effects. Small pilots suggest prebiotics are tolerated and a GI microbiome modulator improved metformin tolerance.
edges.evidence: Secondary analysis of multicenter RCT (n=150), pilot RCT (n=6), crossover (n=10); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Additive glucose lowering: ITF lowered FBG (-0.60 mmol/L) and HbA1c (-0.58%) in prediabetes/T2D; inulin reduced daily insulin need in type 1 diabetes.
edges.evidence: GRADE dose-response MA (33 RCTs), MA (9 RCTs), pilot RCT in T1D; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Acarbose delivers undigested carbohydrate to the colon, causing fermentation-related flatulence; ITF independently increase flatulence. Additive gas/bloating is plausible.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference from acarbose RCT and IBS prebiotic MA; no direct combination study

edges.mechanism: Antibiotic depletion of fermenting bacteria abolishes inulin fermentation effects (prevented fiber-induced HCC in mice); in antibiotic-treated ICU sepsis patients, inulin did not change the microbiome.
edges.evidence: Mouse study plus phase 2 RCT (n=90); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Both are rapidly fermentable bifidogenic prebiotics; stacking adds fermentable load and gas. Beta-GOS improved IBS symptom scores whereas ITF did not, and non-ITF prebiotics reduced flatulence while ITF worsened it.
edges.evidence: Dose-response RCT and IBS meta-analyses; no direct combination trial

edges.mechanism: Gel-forming psyllium (or methylcellulose) co-administered with inulin delays colonic delivery and reduces inulin-induced colonic gas and breath hydrogen.
edges.evidence: Randomized crossover MRI trials in IBS and healthy volunteers; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fructanase hydrolyzes fructans before colonic fermentation, reducing pain, bloating and flatulence after inulin challenge (yields free fructose; see HFI).
edges.evidence: Industry-funded crossover RCT (n=30); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Inulin increases endogenous butyrate production (~44%); sodium butyrate plus inulin was co-administered in T2D without reported safety problems.
edges.evidence: Isotope RCT and 4-arm RCT (n=60); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Tributyrin supplies butyrate directly; inulin raises colonic butyrate production. Combined butyrate+inulin tested in T2D RCT.
edges.evidence: Indirect: isotope RCT and sodium butyrate+inulin RCT; no tributyrin+inulin study

edges.mechanism: Green tea catechins (400 mg/d) plus inulin (2.3 g/d) improved HOMA-IR vs placebo without reducing visceral fat.
edges.evidence: Single industry-funded RCT (n=96); low certainty; contribution of inulin alone unknown

edges.mechanism: Oligofructose-enriched inulin increased fractional magnesium (and calcium) absorption, via colonic fermentation.
edges.evidence: Crossover RCT in postmenopausal women (n=15); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: ITF increase calcium absorption, mainly colonic, and increased bone mineral accretion over 1 year in adolescents; response modified by VDR FokI genotype.
edges.evidence: 1-y RCT, short RCTs and isotope kinetic study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oligofructose-enriched inulin raised serum 25(OH)D by 42% (and vitamin E by 19%) in children with celiac disease on gluten-free diet.
edges.evidence: Pilot RCT (n=34); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Adolescents with the ff genotype had the least initial calcium-absorption response to ITF.
edges.evidence: Genotype subgroup within 1-y RCT; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Inulin fermentation raises breath hydrogen within hours; breath tests call maldigestion at >=20 ppm rise, so recent inulin intake may confound carbohydrate breath testing.
edges.evidence: Challenge studies plus consensus criteria; inferred, not directly studied

edges.mechanism: Exogenous inulin/sinistrin clearance is the reference GFR method; anaphylaxis to IV sinistrin reported. No evidence that oral inulin supplements interfere, as oral inulin is largely unabsorbed.
edges.evidence: Method studies and a case report; very low certainty
